name: Elder Starweave
summary: During the Lunar Festival, Elder Starweave rests in Auberdine as a night elf ancestral spirit. She shares ancient wisdom with pilgrims along Darkshore’s coast.

sections.title: A Beacon in Auberdine
sections.body: In Auberdine, Elder Starweave appears as an ethereal shade among the coastal dwellings. The Cenarion Circle and the peoples of Kalimdor honor her as an ancestor. Travelers pass through the port on their way inland or across the sea, but those who pause before her receive an ancestral blessing. She speaks of the stars, whose paths in this age differ from those of old, and sees them as beacons of hope and fortitude for generations to come.

faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, Elder Starweave appears in Auberdine as a night elf ancestral spirit. She greets travelers, shares ancient wisdom, and offers Coins of Ancestry.

faq.q: Where can Elder Starweave be found?
faq.answer: Elder Starweave can be found near Auberdine, along the shoreline of Darkshore.

faq.q: Why does she appear as a spirit?
faq.answer: Elder Starweave is an honored ancestor who appears in spiritual form during the Lunar Festival, so the living may pay respects to those who shaped the night elves’ distant past.

faq.q: Can Horde players speak to her?
faq.answer: Yes. Ancestral elders honored during the Lunar Festival welcome travelers of every affiliation. Horde adventurers must cross Auberdine, an Alliance-friendly port, with care.

angles.text: As a night elf adventurer in Darkshore, you meet Elder Starweave and connect with your long lineage of forebears, who looked to Elune and the stars through ancient cataclysms.
As a druid observing the festival, you may hear Starweave’s thoughts on the stars echo Cenarion teachings of renewal, memory, and harmony with the natural world.
